Incident: B-32442 gear blanks, 2,000 pieces, material 20CrMnTi, requiring surface hardness of HRC 58~62 and effective case depth of 0.8~1.2 mm after carburizing and quenching. 30 pieces were sampled; measured hardness was HRC 51.5~53.0 and case depth 0.42~0.55 mm; all 30 pieces were below the lower limit, with none conforming.
